caption: The drawing depicts the upper portion of a wooden chair, shown straight-on. The chair is rendered in shades of brown, with varying tones to suggest light and shadow. The upper section of the chair back contains three horizontal slats: the top slat is bordered by a row of shallow, semi-circular cutouts along its lower edge, the middle slat is solid, and the bottom slat features an ornate openwork design comprised of symmetrical, scrolling and curved motifs. Additional decorative cutouts are present on the backrest’s lower panel, with two triangular shapes pointing toward each other from either side, and two arrows pointing away from these triangles, creating a mirrored visual effect. The vertical side supports of the chair are simple and rectangular, except at the base where they curve outward and display a gentle S-shape. The chair legs, arm supports, and details are painted in a muted, soft brown, suggesting the appearance of stained or aged wood. The background of the drawing is a plain, uncolored or off-white surface. The name “Juanita Iañiz” is handwritten in small letters beneath the chair on the right side.
title: Bed
